overview.title: BIS Hallmarking Scheme for Precious Metals
overview.statutory_order: Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery and Gold Artefacts Order, 2020
overview.enforcement_status: Mandatory in 350+ notified districts across India (Phase-I to Phase-V rollout)
overview.description: Hallmarking is the accurate determination and official recording of the proportionate content of precious metal in gold and silver articles. It protects consumers from adulteration and guarantees stated purity.

hallmark_signs.name: BIS Standard Mark
hallmark_signs.description: Certifies that the precious metal artefact conforms to the relevant Indian Standard.

hallmark_signs.name: Purity Grade and Karatage
hallmark_signs.description: Indicates fineness in parts per thousand alongside the corresponding karat grade.

hallmark_signs.name: Hallmark Unique Identification (HUID)
hallmark_signs.description: Unique laser-inscribed code for every individual jewellery piece, enabling complete digital traceability via BIS CARE.

purity_grades.typical_use: Bullion coins, investment bars, special minted artefacts
Primary standard for Indian bridal jewellery, bangles, chains, necklaces
Durable gold ornaments and temple jewellery
Diamond, gemstone, and pearl-studded high-end jewellery
Contemporary lightweight daily-wear and modern western jewellery

consumer_rights.compensation_rule: If hallmarked jewellery is tested in a BIS-recognized referral lab and found of lesser purity than marked, the consumer is entitled to compensation equal to two times the shortfall calculated on prevailing market rate, plus refund of full testing charges.
consumer_rights.testing_for_citizens: Any consumer can get their hallmarked jewellery tested at any BIS-recognized Assaying & Hallmarking Centre (A&HC) on priority by paying nominal testing fee of ₹45 per article.
consumer_rights.mobile_verification: Consumers can instantly verify the authenticity of their hallmarked jewellery by entering the 6-digit HUID in the official BIS CARE mobile application (available on Android & iOS).
